Contact centers often rely on an agent remembering to pause call recording when collecting sensitive personal information. These solutions also fail to redact non-numeric PII such as names, email addresses and mailing addresses. Amazon Transcribe’s redaction feature is purpose-built for identifying PII in conversational transcripts and is highly accurate for both numeric and non-numeric PII.   "text": "Amazon Lightsail now supports resource monitoring, alarming and notifications. Amazon Lightsail now supports resource monitoring, alarming and notifications. With this launch, you can can set up thresholds for each of the monitored metrics for Amazon Lightsail instances, load balancers and databases, and be alerted if the thresholds are exceeded via email and SMS notifications. This feature will allow you to quickly understand the health of your Lightsail infrastructure, and be alerted if there are any issues. This Quick Start deploys Nubeva Transport Layer Security (TLS) Decrypt on the Amazon Web Services (AWS) Cloud in about 10 minutes. The Nubeva TLS Decrypt solution is a software as a service (SaaS) that provides complete packet visibility of any public cloud that uses TLS decryption. All the open-source tools in this solution are complemented by Nubeva TLS Decrypt, which provides additional intelligence and insight into encrypted data. Container-based Nubeva TLS Decrypt sensors are deployed on monitored instances, which capture TLS session keys—as well as associated packet traffic—as they flow through the system. The packets are sent through Amazon VPC traffic mirrors for analysis and visualization by the open-source tools Moloch, Ntop, Suricata, Wireshark, and Zeek. This provides clear visibility of network traffic so you can identify unexpected network behavior, perform network analysis, and detect intrusions.
